name: PrintableTools Lab Sponsor Deal Room

deals.title: Starter fit review
deals.bestFor: A sponsor wants to know whether their product is safe and relevant before buying a visible placement.
deals.deliverable: Manual sponsor-fit review, audience match, recommended page family, and safe next-step copy.
deals.proofNeeded: Company URL, product category, intended audience, and any placement rules.

deals.title: Guide sponsor pilot
deals.bestFor: A PDF, image, QR, career, classroom, or small-business product wants one clearly labeled pilot mention.
deals.deliverable: One manually approved, clearly labeled sponsor mention on a relevant guide or resource page.
deals.proofNeeded: Campaign fit, sponsor copy draft, safe landing URL, and category exclusions.

deals.title: Vertical category pilot
deals.bestFor: A partner cares about one audience such as QR/local marketing, resume/career, classroom, or small-business paperwork.
deals.deliverable: Tracked vertical sponsor page, fit review, and one approved contextual placement candidate.
deals.proofNeeded: Target vertical, audience fit, sponsor category, and safe public landing URL.

deals.title: Partner distribution test
deals.bestFor: A newsletter, directory, resource page, or community wants to test relevant traffic before a paid placement.
deals.deliverable: Tracked partner link, source attribution, and review against page views, depth, downloads, or lead signal.
deals.proofNeeded: Partner page, expected audience, planned link context, and review window.

verticals.title: PDF, Image, and QR SaaS Sponsorship
verticals.audience: Visitors fixing PDF size limits, converting images, making static QR codes, and choosing no-upload browser utilities.
verticals.sponsorFit: PDF APIs, image optimization tools, QR platforms, privacy-friendly document automation, browser utility products, and file-workflow SaaS.
verticals.pitch: Reach people who already have a file, upload, conversion, or QR job in progress.

verticals.title: Resume and Career Tool Sponsorship
verticals.audience: Job seekers creating resume PDFs, checking ATS keywords, fixing resume upload size limits, and preparing application documents.
verticals.sponsorFit: Resume builders, ATS tools, job boards, interview prep products, career coaching, and applicant-document utilities.
verticals.pitch: Reach visitors at the moment they are preparing or fixing job-application documents.

verticals.title: Classroom Printable Sponsorship
verticals.audience: Teachers, homeschool families, and parents making free printable learning, planning, and classroom-management PDFs.
verticals.sponsorFit: Teacher marketplaces, homeschool resources, classroom apps, learning printables, family routine products, and child-safe educational tools.
verticals.pitch: Reach classroom and homeschool visitors while keeping child-safety and ad-safety review strict.

verticals.title: Small Business Paperwork Sponsorship
verticals.audience: Freelancers, local sellers, home-service operators, and small teams creating simple business PDFs and print assets.
verticals.sponsorFit: Invoicing apps, bookkeeping tools, POS products, local marketing services, shipping tools, label systems, and small-business operations software.
verticals.pitch: Reach small-business visitors while they are making paperwork or local promotion files.

verticals.title: Local Marketing and QR Sponsorship
verticals.audience: Local services, shops, event organizers, and small teams creating QR codes, flyers, coupons, signs, and printable promotion assets.
verticals.sponsorFit: QR platforms, review-request tools, local SEO products, print shops, signage services, event tools, and small-business marketing software.
verticals.pitch: Reach visitors making offline-to-online assets for local promotion.

requiredReview: Company/product fit must be relevant to free PDF, image, QR, career, classroom, or small-business workflows.
Sponsor copy must be clearly labeled and manually approved before placement.
Downloads stay free and cannot require sponsor interaction, ad clicks, accounts, or payment.
No gambling, adult, deceptive finance, malware, fake document, misleading upload-service, or unsafe claims.
moneyGate: Revenue is real only after a sponsor agreement or settled external payment is verified. Deal-room visits, clicks, and lead submissions are operating signals.
